# Legacy 0.3-era fixture provenance

This tree is a byte-exact snapshot of `tests/fixtures/proof-bundle` as of the
pre-1.0 corrections commit. That bundle was generated by Agentflow tool version
0.3.0 and records proof-pack schema 0.4.0; it is the "preserved legacy fixture"
issue #5 requires the compatibility matrix to keep verifying forever.

It was copied here because `tests/fixtures/proof-bundle` is the live bundle the
CI workflow runs `verify-run` against, and `verify-run` carries no cross-major
promise (`docs/compatibility.md`). The 1.0 transition therefore regenerates
`tests/fixtures/proof-bundle` with the 1.0 code, while this snapshot stays
immutable under the compatibility tree so the historical `verify-proof`
guarantee keeps being exercised against a genuine 0.3-era artifact.

Only `PROVENANCE.md` (this file) was added on top of the copy; every other byte
matches the source bundle. `verify-proof` validates the hashed artifacts under
`.agent/`, so this extra documentation file does not affect verification.
